notes: Reveal targets are restricted to SST hypotheses that predate the blind seal.
The electron carrier is identified in SST with the trefoil knot 3_1.
No numerical Hopf charge is assigned here because knot type K and Hopf charge Q_H are independent invariants in the current SST research track.
No self-link proxy target is supplied because SST had no preregistered numerical Wr+Tw prediction for the electron trefoil.
No helicity-ratio target is supplied because the blind H5 calculation is only an identity benchmark and no independent SST velocity/vorticity field was used.
spin_sector_k=1 records the pre-existing minimal nontrivial spin-1/2 quantization hypothesis; it is not treated as derived.
4pi spinor kinematics is a pre-existing requirement of the proposed SST spinor interpretation.
